entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 18.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Radhanagar P.S. Case No.149 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 376, 511, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
4. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that as per the allegation the incident is dated 11.06.2022 while the FIR has been lodged on 03.07.2022.
In fact, neighbourhood dispute has been settled otherwise.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 6 . Considering the period of custody, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail,
on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned J.M.-1st Class, Rajmahal in connection with Radhanagar P.S. Case No.149 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
